meta.purpose: R-30 and R-31. Risk for every decision path, including business-as-usual events and black-swan events, and a view on which path best preserves wealth at a manageable level of risk.

scoring_key.likelihood: Qualitative, anchored on verified evidence where any exists. Not a probability.
scoring_key.impact: Share of the asset's value at risk, expressed qualitatively until G-01 and G-08 close.
scoring_key.preventability: Can the owner eliminate this by acting? Yes / Partly / No.

meta.honesty_note: No probability is assigned to any event. Assigning one would be a fabrication in the absence of an insured loss model. The comparisons below are ordinal, not cardinal.

decision_paths.path: Sell during the current lease term
decision_paths.summary: Exchange the leased property for liquidity at a price established by current, verified buyer offers and applicable transaction costs.

decision_paths.path: Market now, close after the tenant's written renewal indication
decision_paths.summary: Use a live market test to discover the price while holding an option to change course.
Exchange some liquidity for contractual term and rent certainty, subject to verified renewal terms, credit support and owner objectives.

decision_paths.path: Hold to expiry, then re-let or redevelop
decision_paths.summary: Retain the property through lease expiry and assess re-leasing, redevelopment or disposition; account for vacancy, capital costs and land-use constraints.
Explore a tenant purchase or sale-leaseback only if the tenant confirms interest and legal, financing and lease structures support it; price and feasibility are unknown.
Evaluate a qualifying like-kind exchange as a distinct tax and reinvestment scenario; eligibility, replacement assets, concentration and costs require adviser review.
Defer a commitment while obtaining evidence. This preserves options temporarily but leaves existing lease, market and property risks in place.

risks.risk: Tenant closes this unit before lease expiry
risks.evidence: 86 Jack in the Box closures in FY2025, 38 under JACK on Track; FY2026 guidance of 50-100 further closures (S-02). Same-store sales -4.2% FY2025 and -7.4% in Q4 (S-02).
risks.likelihood: Store-specific likelihood unknown; cited company-wide closures are context only
risks.impact: Unknown for this parcel — lease remedies, tenant operations, alternative uses and buyer demand are not verified
risks.preventability: No for the closure itself; Partly for the consequences, via lease covenants at renewal
risks.mitigation: Obtain a written renewal indication before renewing. Negotiate a go-dark restriction and a recapture right at first opportunity.

risks.risk: Potential real rent erosion if contractual escalation is below inflation
risks.evidence: LA CPI-U grew at 3.79%/yr over 2019-2025 (S-07). A 2% fixed bump against that is roughly a 1.8 point real decline per year, compounding.
risks.likelihood: Depends entirely on the escalation clause — unknown (G-05)
risks.impact: Medium to high over a 5 to 9 year window
risks.preventability: Only at renewal, by negotiating a market reset
risks.mitigation: Close G-05 before renewing; do not renew on the existing mechanism without testing it.

risks.risk: Potential buyer-pool depth and short-lease pricing sensitivity
risks.impact: Unknown — no parcel-specific quotes or comparable transactions are available
risks.preventability: Unknown — buyer response to remaining term must be established with current written bids
risks.mitigation: Obtain written offers with actual term and consistent assumptions; no short-lease discount is estimated.

risks.risk: Seismic event may damage the building or affect use (scenario)
risks.evidence: The parcel's zone status is unknown (HZ-01 to HZ-04). The region is seismically active; USGS NSHM 2023 is the current model (S-22).
risks.likelihood: Unknown; parcel-specific hazard and engineering findings unavailable
risks.impact: Unknown — no parcel-specific loss, insurance or rent-interruption model
risks.preventability: Depends on engineering, insurance, lease allocation and mitigation options; unverified
risks.mitigation: Complete HZ-01 to HZ-04, obtain PML, and hold insurance where the deductible is survivable. Assess this scenario symmetrically against sale, renewal and deferral; parcel-specific engineering, insurance and lease terms are unknown.

risks.risk: Fast-food wage policy may affect operator costs (context)
risks.evidence: Fast-food minimum wage $20.00/hr since 2024-04-01 under AB 1228, with a Fast Food Council empowered to raise it further (S-18). State minimum wage $16.90 from 2026-01-01, indexed to CPI-W capped at 3.5%/yr (S-17). CPI-W 12-month change is 4.1% (S-05).
risks.likelihood: Unknown for this tenant/store; policy and wage changes do not establish unit outcomes
risks.impact: Unknown for this tenant/store; no store-level cost or margin data
risks.mitigation: Confirm how the tenant and this location are affected before using wage changes in a renewal or rent-coverage analysis.

risks.evidence: Not verified this session (HZ-09). Stated as a known structural pressure on California property insurance, flagged as an assumption.
risks.impact: Unknown — no parcel-specific insurance quote or buyer evidence
risks.mitigation: Obtain three written insurance indications before marketing (HZ-09).

risks.risk: A like-kind exchange may not meet timing or execution requirements
risks.evidence: Statutory identification and acquisition clocks apply (S-15).
risks.likelihood: Unknown; execution risk depends on owner, advisers and transaction facts
risks.impact: Owner- and transaction-specific; quantify with qualified tax counsel
risks.mitigation: Identify replacement candidates before listing. Treat 1031 as optional, never as a reason to accept a bad price.

risks.risk: Disposition tax differs from initial estimate (scenario)
risks.evidence: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain at up to 25% (S-12), NIIT 3.8% (S-13), California top marginal 12.3% with no capital-gain preference (S-16).
risks.likelihood: Unknown until adjusted basis, depreciation and transaction structure are verified
risks.impact: Unknown; calculate from owner-specific basis, depreciation, tax status and transaction costs
risks.mitigation: Close G-03 and run the calculator before signing anything.

risks.risk: Tenant real-estate actions may affect transaction conditions (unverified)
risks.evidence: The tenant's FY2026 guidance explicitly names 'selling real estate' as part of JACK on Track (S-02).
risks.likelihood: Unknown — public filing does not establish activity in this market or subject property
risks.impact: Unknown — no verified property-level impact or buyer-pool evidence
risks.mitigation: Do not assume the tenant will buy or sell this property; confirm its interest and obtain independent bids.

risks.risk: Regional employment and population context does not establish local demand
risks.evidence: MSA nonfarm employment +1.29% versus 2019 and +0.19% versus 2024 (derived from S-06). City population -0.8% since 2020 (S-08). Information -2.1%, Financial Activities -1.6%, Manufacturing -1.2% (S-05).
risks.likelihood: Observed regional history; not a parcel forecast
risks.impact: Unknown — site-level demand and sensitivity are not established
risks.mitigation: Use parcel-selected trade-area evidence and avoid forecasting rent from regional aggregates alone.

risks.risk: Vacancy after lease expiry exceeds an illustrative scenario
risks.likelihood: Unknown — no parcel zoning, lease or reletting evidence
risks.impact: Unknown — permissible uses and tenant market have not been verified
risks.mitigation: Close G-11. Permitted uses and redevelopment feasibility require parcel-specific zoning and entitlement review.

risks.risk: Portfolio concentration cannot be assessed from public property evidence
risks.evidence: The owner's other holdings are unknown and not requested. Stated as a structural point.
risks.likelihood: Unknown; depends on owner-specific balance sheet and objectives
risks.impact: Unknown until the owner's confidential portfolio and objectives are assessed with authorized advisers.
risks.mitigation: State the objective function (G-12). Portfolio concentration is unknown; assess it with the owner's advisers as one input alongside price, tax, liquidity and risk limits.

black_swan_block.summary: Rare events that could destroy the local economy, and what each does to the three stress legs.

events.rent_leg: Scenario: rent may be interrupted if damage, access restrictions or tenant closure affect payment; confirm lease remedies and insurance.
events.repair_leg: Scenario: test verified repair estimates, deductibles, exclusions and code-upgrade exposure.
events.liquidity_leg: Scenario: test sale timing and pricing under reduced market activity; no probability is assigned.
events.net: Combined stress scenario only; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate is available.

events.event: Urban wildfire reaching dense commercial corridors
events.rent_leg: Scenario: if the parcel or access is affected, test rent interruption and tenant closure under the lease.
events.repair_leg: Scenario: test damage, cleanup, rebuilding requirements and insured recovery.
events.liquidity_leg: Scenario: test insurance availability and transaction pricing without assuming a regional withdrawal.
events.net: Combined stress scenario only; parcel exposure, insurance response and market effects are unverified.

events.rent_leg: Tenant distress could impair rent collection.
events.repair_leg: Maintenance needs may coincide with reduced cash flow.
events.liquidity_leg: Buyer depth or pricing could deteriorate.
events.net: Scenario only; no probability or parcel-specific loss estimate is assigned.

events.event: Regulatory change affecting QSR operating costs (scenario)
events.rent_leg: Scenario: test whether a verified rule change affects this tenant or store and its capacity to pay.
events.repair_leg: No direct property damage assumed; assess any compliance work separately.
events.liquidity_leg: Test any market repricing with actual buyer evidence; no re-rating is assumed.
events.net: Scenario only; current policy does not establish the effect on this property.

black_swan_block.design_principle: Evaluate concentration, lease term, tenant credit, hazard exposure, insurance limits and deductibles, repair costs, rent interruption and exit liquidity together. The appropriate holding horizon and risk tolerance depend on verified parcel and owner-specific facts; no sell-or-hold conclusion follows from regional hazard context alone.

best_course_of_action.headline: Conditional, and the condition is sequencing — not a target price.
reasoning: Regional employment, population and sector figures are context only; they do not measure the parcel's trade area, access, competition or local demand.
Tenant-wide operating and unit disclosures are context only; they do not establish this lease's obligor, guaranty, store performance, rent coverage or renewal intent.
A potential section 1031 exchange is a separate tax scenario subject to owner-, asset- and transaction-specific eligibility and deadlines; it is not evidence that selling is preferable.
Hazard, rent-interruption, repair and liquidity stresses should be modelled symmetrically for sale and hold using parcel-specific engineering, insurance and financial inputs.
Neither sale value nor hold value can be determined without verified lease terms, current written bids, tax basis, renewal terms and the owner's objectives.

recommended_sequence.action: Complete the blocking evidence gates (G-01, G-02, G-03, G-04, G-07, G-12) before commitment.
recommended_sequence.why: These inputs are necessary to build comparable sale and hold cases.

recommended_sequence.action: Obtain written quotes from three buyers AND a written renewal indication from the tenant, in the same 30-day window.
recommended_sequence.why: This is the only way to compare a real sale price against a real renewal case rather than two templates.

recommended_sequence.action: Ask the tenant, through the broker, whether it will buy the parcel.
recommended_sequence.why: A path to test only if the tenant and transaction structure make it available; interest and ability remain unverified.

recommended_sequence.action: Run the after-tax number with and without a section 1031 exchange, and identify replacement candidates before listing.
recommended_sequence.why: Compare the exchange case only if a CPA confirms eligibility and models costs, timing and alternatives.

recommended_sequence.action: Decide against the owner's written objective function (G-12).
recommended_sequence.why: Sell and hold optimise different things. That trade-off belongs to the owner and cannot be delegated to an analysis.

best_course_of_action.decision_status: No sell-or-renew recommendation is supportable from the public and aggregate evidence currently available. The lease abstract, parcel-specific evidence, actual buyer quotes, tax basis, renewal terms, and the owner's written objectives are missing. Compare verified after-tax sale and renewal cases only after those inputs are obtained; do not treat regional or tenant-wide trends as parcel-level proof.
evidence_to_assess_hold_case: A firm term extending meaningfully past 2032, with no tenant termination right.
A corporate or well-capitalised guaranty behind the rent.
A renewal option with a fair-market-value reset rather than a fixed bump.
Parcel-level hazard findings that are benign, plus affordable insurance.
Zoning headroom that gives the land a credible alternative use.
Three written quotes that come in materially above the owner's hold-case present value.
